svg.title: Devices — Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G, Redmi Note 7 and iPhone 12
svg.desc: Original illustrations of three phones with their specifications. Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G (garnet): Snapdragon 7s Gen 2, 6.67-inch 120 Hz AMOLED, 200 MP camera, 5100 mAh. Redmi Note 7 (lavender): Snapdragon 660, 6.3-inch LCD, 48 MP camera, 4000 mAh. iPhone 12: A14 Bionic, 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED, dual 12 MP cameras.
